study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities unveil two neuroanatomical obsessive-compulsive disorder subtypes

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study recruited 100 first-episode untreated OCD patients and 106 healthy controls from a single site (The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University). No named public dataset was used. An additional separate dataset of 492 healthy individuals from a single site (Southwest University adult lifespan dataset, reference [46]) was used solely for constructing the structural covariance network, not for the normative model.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "A total of 100 first-episode, untreated patients diagnosed with OCD were recruited from outpatient services within the Department of Psychiatry at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University." ... "Healthy controls (HCs, n = 106) were enlisted from the community via poster advertisements." ... "The normal structural covariance network was constructed using another extensive dataset from a single site, comprising 492 healthy individuals aged 19-80 years."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Wen2025.pdf.md: Methods / Participants, L39; Methods / Disease epicenter mapping for each subtype, L65

answer.SINGLE-SITE: normative model training (106 HCs) and clinical application (100 OCD patients)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The 106 healthy controls were used to train the Gaussian process regression normative model estimating normative ranges of regional gray matter volumes from age and sex. The 100 OCD patients were then evaluated against this normative model to generate individualized deviation (Z-score) maps. A separate external dataset (492 healthy individuals from reference [46]) was used only for structural covariance network construction, not for the normative model itself.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we trained a Gaussian process regression model to estimate the normative range of regional GMVs from age and sex in HCs according to the brain connectome atlas. This trained model was then applied to each patient to generate predicted GMVs."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study used 106 healthy controls to build the normative model. No explicit train/validation/test split within the HC group is described; the paper states the model was trained on HCs and then applied to patients. Therefore overall-phase is 106 and train-phase details are not reported separately.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Table 1 reports the HC group age as mean 23.09 (SD 5.63) years. No separate train-phase statistics are reported since the paper does not describe a train/test split within the HC group. Median, IQR, min, and max are not reported.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Table 1 reports 53 males (50.00%) among 106 HCs. By subtraction, female_n = 106 - 53 = 53 (50.0%). No separate train-phase breakdown is available since no train/test split within HCs is described.
